# Vora International Limited

> Vora International supplies, installs and maintains certified water, sanitation and hygiene products and services for schools, clinics, offices, churches, hotels and food businesses across Kenya. Based in Nairobi. Tagline: Clean water. Safe sanitation. Everyday hygiene.

## About

- Legal name: Vora International Limited
- Location: Nairobi, Kenya. Serves institutions nationwide.
- Contact: hello@vorainternational.com
- Website: https://vorainternational.com
- Community arm: Vora Foundation, which delivers hygiene, sanitation, safe water and menstrual health education in Kenyan schools.

## What Vora supplies

Water: bulk drinking water (500 ml and 20 L), water dispensers, water treatment, filters, storage tanks.
Sanitation: toilet tissue, pedal waste and sanitary bins, cleaning and disinfectant, sensor taps and washroom fittings.
Hygiene: hygiene stations, liquid soap, hand sanitiser, sanitary pads.
Services: facility assessments, installation and maintenance, scheduled resupply, branded products.

## How it works

1. Facility assessment on site, free of charge.
2. Written plan with costs and priorities.
3. Supply and installation of certified products, tested and handed over.
4. Standing orders on fixed delivery days, with scheduled servicing.
5. Return visit to confirm everything works.

## Commitments

- Only KEBS-certified products, with permit records available on request.
- At least two verified suppliers per product category.
- Fixed delivery days with on-time performance reported to the customer.
- Formal invoices, delivery notes and service reports.
- Minimum order of five units per product line.
